what.text: People were displaced internally within Yemen, while others were recorded as refugees or asylum seekers abroad.
Internal displacement from conflict or violence reached 4795983 people at the end of 2025.
In 2025, there were also 57327 refugees and 25860 asylum seekers originating from Yemen.

why.text: Recorded conflict episodes include the Government of Yemen (North Yemen) fighting Ansarallah, AQAP, and other groups between 2008 and 2025.
Additional conflicts involved IS (Islamic State), STC (South Yemen), Israel, the United Kingdom, and the United States of America.
Disaster events occurred in the same years, with 263991 new disaster movements recorded in 2025.

when.text: Conflict-related internal displacement stood at 175000 people in 2009 and reached 4795983 in 2025.
New conflict movements were 2174968 in 2015 and 56798 in 2025.

how.text: In 2025, UNHCR reported protecting or assisting 4795983 internally displaced people inside Yemen.
Disaster displacement figures showed 10836 people remaining displaced by disasters at the end of 2021.
The sources don't say what specific routes people took or how they live.
